sentences.en: From The New York Times, this is The Interview.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，这里是《访谈》。

sentences.en: I'm David Marchese.
sentences.zh: 我是大卫·马尔凯塞。

sentences.en: A lot of people wind their way into middle age, having achieved some measure of career success, only to ask themselves, well, now what?
sentences.zh: 很多人摸索着步入中年，在取得了一定程度的职业成功后，却忍不住问自己：好吧，接下来呢？

sentences.en: And apparently this happens even if you're Serena WilliaMs.
sentences.zh: 显然，哪怕你是塞雷娜·威廉姆斯，也会遇到这种情况。

sentences.en: Serena, who's now 42 years old, retired from competitive tennis a little under two years ago.
sentences.zh: 塞雷娜今年42岁，在不到两年前退出了网球竞技赛场。

sentences.en: She'd won 23 grand slams, more than any woman in the open era, and just one shy of the all-time record.
sentences.zh: 她曾赢得23座大满贯奖杯，比公开赛年代的任何女性都多，距离历史纪录也只差一个。

sentences.en: Her level of fame and achievement, both on and off the court, broke boundaries for black women and women athletes in general.
sentences.zh: 无论是在球场内外，她的名气和成就都为黑人女性乃至全体女性运动员打破了界限。

sentences.en: She is, by just about any account, the best ever at what she did.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有人都公认，她在她所从事的领域是有史以来最伟大的。

sentences.en: Since she retired, Williams has directed that drive at some new projects.
sentences.zh: 自退役以来，威廉姆斯将这股冲劲投入到了一些新项目中。

sentences.en: She's got a venture capital fund and just launched a makeup line.
sentences.zh: 她创立了一家风险投资基金，最近还推出了一个彩妆系列。

sentences.en: And she and her husband, Reddit co-founder Alexis Ohanian, have two small girls.
sentences.zh: 她和丈夫——Reddit联合创始人亚历克西斯·奥哈尼安——育有两个年幼的女儿。

sentences.en: So it's not exactly like she's been idle.
sentences.zh: 所以，她可算不上闲着。

sentences.en: But the tennis court still calls.
sentences.zh: 但网球场仍在召唤她。

sentences.en: She's gone back to it, in a way, with a new eight-part documentary called In the Arena,
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，她通过一部名为《身处竞技场》的全新八集纪录片回到了网球世界，

sentences.en: Serena Williams, which will stream on ESPN Plus next month.
sentences.zh: 该纪录片将于下个月在ESPN Plus上播放。

sentences.en: And she told me that revisiting her career through the series has been the first chance she's had to sit back and take in everything she accomplished.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，通过这个系列回顾自己的职业生涯，是她第一次有机会坐下来，细细品味她所取得的一切成就。

sentences.en: Here's my conversation with Serena WilliaMs.
sentences.zh: 以下是我与塞雷娜·威廉姆斯的对话。

sentences.en: So you've been retired from tennis for, it's not even two full years.
sentences.zh: 所以你从网坛退役已经……甚至还没满两年。

sentences.en: And one thing that I was thinking about in watching the documentary was really the kind of amazing competitive spirit that you had.
sentences.zh: 我在看这部纪录片时想到的其中一件事，确实是你身上那种惊人的好胜心。

sentences.en: And I'm curious about where that competitive spirit goes or how it changes once you're no longer playing sports.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，一旦你不再进行体育运动，那种好胜心会去哪里，或者它是如何改变的？

sentences.en: You know, you're doing the different projects, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你在做不同的项目，对吧？

sentences.en: You've got the venture capital fund, the makeup line.
sentences.zh: 你有风险投资基金，还有彩妆系列。

sentences.en: I think you've written a children's book.
sentences.zh: 我想你还写了一本儿童读物。

sentences.en: Did you feel like you, like, does it go away the next day?
sentences.zh: 你有没有觉得，比如，它第二天就消失了？

sentences.en: Or did you feel like you had to find a new outlet for it?
sentences.zh: 还是说你觉得你必须为它找到一个新的宣泄口？

sentences.en: For me, it was a necessary thing.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这是一件必须要做的事。

sentences.en: Like, I needed to not sit, be done and sit down and wake up and be like, oh my God, what had, what just happened?
sentences.zh: 就像，我需要不能就这么坐着、结束了然后坐下来，一觉醒来心想：天哪，刚、刚刚发生了什么？

sentences.en: For me, it was like, thank goodness that I did something that maybe anyone would say was too faSt.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，就像是，幸好我做了一件可能别人会觉得太快了的事。

sentences.en: And not maybe, it was definitely too fast to just throw myself full heart, full body into everything.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅是可能，绝对是太快了，就是全身心、全副身心投入到每件事中。

sentences.en: But that's kind of what I needed to do to survive, so to say, after I've been playing tennis for all my life.
sentences.zh: 但可以说，为了生存，这就是我当时需要做的事情，因为我打了一辈子网球。

sentences.en: I think it would have been really hard.
sentences.zh: 我想这会非常艰难。

sentences.en: So I just kind of did all that.
sentences.zh: 所以我差不多就是把这些都做了。

sentences.en: And when you say something you sort of needed to survive, you mean because you were sort of worried or anxious about the prospect of not having new challenges once tennis was done?
sentences.zh: 当你说是某种你为了生存需要做的事情时，你的意思是，因为你对网球生涯结束后没有新挑战的前景感到担忧或焦虑吗？

sentences.en: No, it wasn't about not having new challenges.
sentences.zh: 不，这不是关于没有新挑战的问题。

sentences.en: I think it was more around the fact of like, listen, you've been doing this since you've been born.
sentences.zh: 我觉得更多的是围绕着这样一点：听着，你从出生起就一直在做这件事。

sentences.en: Do you even know how to do anything else?
sentences.zh: 你甚至知道怎么做别的事吗？

sentences.en: My whole mission in life was playing tennis, waking up every day.
sentences.zh: 我生活中的全部使命就是打网球，每天醒来。

sentences.en: What are you doing today?
sentences.zh: 你今天要做什么？

sentences.en: Practice.
sentences.zh: 训练。

sentences.en: What are you going to do?
sentences.zh: 你打算做什么？

sentences.en: Train.
sentences.zh: 体能训练。

sentences.en: And then if you get injured, then you're like, what are you doing today?
sentences.zh: 然后如果你受伤了，你就会想：你今天要做什么？

sentences.en: Rehab, you know, so I can't get back to practice.
sentences.zh: 康复治疗，你知道的，这样我才能回到训练场。

sentences.en: And that had been my life for over 40 years.
sentences.zh: 这就是我40多年来的生活。

sentences.en: And so it was like, you don't go from literally a 40 year career to just going, okay, what do you do today?
sentences.zh: 所以这就好比，你不可能从一个长达40年的职业生涯中直接过渡到说：好吧，你今天要做什么？

sentences.en: Nothing.
sentences.zh: 什么都不做。

sentences.en: You know, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我不知道。

sentences.en: So I kind of needed to just, I think all this was subconscious too.
sentences.zh: 所以我差不多需要去……我觉得这一切也都是潜意识的。

sentences.en: I obviously wasn't doing this on purpose, but I think I subconsciously just kind of overlapped.
sentences.zh: 我显然不是故意这么做的，但我认为我只是在潜意识里做了一个无缝衔接。

sentences.en: So when my career didn't, like literally the next day I had a huge team meeting for Serena
sentences.zh: 所以当我的职业生涯……就像字面意义上的第二天，我就为塞雷娜

sentences.en: Ventures.
sentences.zh: 风投（Serena Ventures）

sentences.en: We were talking about companies.
sentences.zh: 开了一场大型团队会议。

sentences.en: I had fully taken over and it was just like all hands, all me on deck.
sentences.zh: 我们在讨论公司的事情。

sentences.en: And I was on every single meeting.
sentences.zh: 我已经完全接管了，感觉就像是全员出动，全副精力都在我身上。

sentences.en: I was in every founder meeting.
sentences.zh: 我参加了每一个会议。

sentences.en: I was in everything.
sentences.zh: 我参加了每一个创始人的会议。

sentences.en: And again, I think it was too much, but I think that was my way of coping because I couldn't go from having purpose for all my life to having no purpose.
sentences.zh: 我什么都参与。再次重申，我觉得这有点过头了，但我觉得那是我的应对方式，因为我无法从一生都有目标变成一生都没有目标。

sentences.en: Does the having purpose aspect of things also include like the scheduling and how you're spending your time?
sentences.zh: 关于生活有目标这一方面，是否也包括日程安排以及你如何度过时间？

sentences.en: Like, did you want to maintain kind of a strict or rigorous schedule for yourself?
sentences.zh: 比如，你是否想为自己维持一种严格或规律的日程？

sentences.en: You know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: No, I didn't know that that's what I was doing for the record.
sentences.zh: 不，老实说，我当时并不知道这就是我在做的事。

sentences.en: I didn't realize that.
sentences.zh: 我没有意识到这一点。

sentences.en: But now I'm like wanting to figure out a way to take a break, which I probably should have done earlier.
sentences.zh: 但现在我想要找出一种方法来休息一下，我本该早点这么做的。

sentences.en: But I don't know if I would have mentally survived that because of my personality.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道以我的性格，我是否能在精神上熬过那个阶段。

sentences.en: I probably would have been back on the tennis court playing tennis.
sentences.zh: 我可能早就回到网球场上打网球了。

sentences.en: But yeah, now I'm just like, I haven't stopped in my whole life.
sentences.zh: 但是的，现在我只是觉得：我这一生都没有停下过。

sentences.en: I've been going nonstop for my entire life.
sentences.zh: 我一辈子都在马不停蹄地前进。

sentences.en: So I kind of need a breather.
sentences.zh: 所以我有点需要喘口气。

sentences.en: I need to, I really desperately need a breather.
sentences.zh: 我需要，我真的非常渴望喘口气。

sentences.en: So I'm trying to navigate all that now.
sentences.zh: 所以我现在正在努力应对这一切。

sentences.en: Your kids are still pretty young, right?
sentences.zh: 你的孩子还很小，对吧？

sentences.en: My, I have two girls.
sentences.zh: 我的，我有两个女孩。

sentences.en: One is eight months and one is six years old.
sentences.zh: 一个八个月大，一个六岁大。

sentences.en: And is there a particular understanding that you want your daughters to have about what you accomplished in tennis?
sentences.zh: 你是否希望你的女儿们对你在网球上取得的成就有一种特别的理解？

sentences.en: Um, it's kind of, it's tricky, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，这有点，这挺棘手的，对吧？

sentences.en: Because it's like, I want them to understand, but at the same time, that'll come with time.
sentences.zh: 因为这就像，我希望她们理解，但与此同时，这需要时间。

sentences.en: So I'm not really to, to, you know, Olympia told me the other day, like, you're famous.
sentences.zh: 所以我并不是真的要去……你知道的，奥林匹亚前几天对我说，比如，你是个名人。

sentences.en: And I'm like, eh, not really.
sentences.zh: 而我说：呃，其实不算。

sentences.en: I'm just your mom.
sentences.zh: 我只是你妈妈。

sentences.en: Um, so I don't know.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以我不知道。

sentences.en: I just feel like when the time comes and honestly, when it's settled in for me too, I know that
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得当那个时刻到来时，老实说，当我自个儿也真正沉淀下来时——

sentences.en: sounds really crazy, but when it's all settled in for me, I'll definitely have that conversation
sentences.zh: 我知道这听起来很疯狂，但当一切都在我心里沉淀下来后，我一定会和她们进行那次谈话，

sentences.en: with them and I'll let them know, like, you know, potentially the important, you know, the, I don't want to be too presumptuous, but the impact I had, I should say, the impact
sentences.zh: 我会让她们知道，比如，你知道的，潜在的重要……你知道的，我不想显得太自负，但我应该说，我所产生的影响，

sentences.en: that I have had and on sport and beyond.
sentences.zh: 我对这项运动及以外领域产生的影响。

sentences.en: You know, your, your dad famously saw something in you and in Venus and then worked so hard to help you guys achieve that.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，众所周知，你父亲在你和大威身上看到了某种特质，然后付出了巨大的努力来帮助你们实现目标。

sentences.en: Um, and he saw something in you and her sister when, when you guys were real little.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当你们真的很小的时候，他在你和你姐姐身上看到了某种特质。

sentences.en: And I wonder, do you feel like you see something in your daughters in the way that your dad saw something in you?
sentences.zh: 我想知道，你是否觉得在你的女儿们身上看到了某种特质，就像你父亲当年在你身上看到的那样？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: That's a really good question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常好的问题。

sentences.en: I feel like, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，我不知道。

sentences.en: I, I always look at my dad and I think, how are you able to do that?
sentences.zh: 我总是看着我父亲，然后心想：你是怎么做到这一点的？

sentences.en: Because I'm like, oh, they're so cute.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得，噢，她们太可爱了。

sentences.en: I just want them to relax and I don't want to over push them, but I would be devastated if I wasn't pushed because I wouldn't, we wouldn't be having this interview and there
sentences.zh: 我只想让她们放松，我不想过分逼迫她们，但如果我当初没有被逼迫，我会感到非常崩溃，因为我不会……我们今天就不会在这里做这个访谈，也永远不会有塞雷娜·威廉姆斯。

sentences.en: would never have been a Serena WilliaMs.
sentences.zh: 也永远不会有塞雷娜·威廉姆斯。

sentences.en: So I feel so fortunate that I had an opportunity to have that extra, you know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 所以我感到非常幸运，我有机会获得了那种额外的……你知道我的意思吗？

sentences.en: But for whatever reason, I'm having a hard time connecting to like that extra push.
sentences.zh: 但不管出于什么原因，我很难让自己去跟那种“额外的督促”产生连接。

sentences.en: And that's something that I've been trying to figure out myself is like how to get that extra motivation to my daughters.
sentences.zh: 这也是我一直在自己琢磨的事情，就是如何把那股额外的动力传递给我的女儿们。

sentences.en: Cause it's definitely worth it.
sentences.zh: 因为这绝对是值得的。

sentences.en: I can confirm from experience.
sentences.zh: 我可以根据经验向你证实。

sentences.en: It worked out pretty well for you.
sentences.zh: 这对你来说结果相当不错。

sentences.en: It worked out well.
sentences.zh: 结果很不错。

sentences.en: Um, but what do I see?
sentences.zh: 嗯，但我看到了什么？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I think my oldest, I mean, the eight month old is so tiny, but I think Olympia is such a bright light and she's so athletic to a point where it's just not even humanly possible.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我的大女儿……我是说，八个月大的那个太小了，但我觉得奥林匹亚就像一颗耀眼的小星星，她极其富有运动天赋，甚至到了简直超乎人类极限的地步。

sentences.en: And my, even Venus, she was like, that kid has more talent than you and I combined.
sentences.zh: 而我……甚至连大威都曾说过：“那孩子的才华比你我加起来还要多。”

sentences.en: And she's not lying.
sentences.zh: 她可没有撒谎。

sentences.en: So it's, it's, I can see how my dad may have seen some potential in us.
sentences.zh: 所以，这……我能理解我父亲当年是怎么在我们身上看到一些潜力的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So for me, I'm just like trying to figure out a way how to like harness all that and just do that.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，我只是在想方设法如何驾驭这一切，并付诸行动。

sentences.en: I'm like, I already told my dad, like, maybe you have to coach her because I'm, I'm too nice.
sentences.zh: 我甚至对父亲说：也许你得去当她的教练，因为我……我太心软了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You're too soft.
sentences.zh: 你太温柔了。

sentences.en: I'm too soft.
sentences.zh: 我太温柔了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: There you go.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: You know, I can imagine it's sort of an interesting thing that a lot of parents have to think about.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我可以想象，这大概是许多父母都得思考的一个有趣问题。

sentences.en: It's, it's like you do the hard work and push yourself on some level, maybe so that your kids don't have to do the hard work, but then you also want them to achieve.
sentences.zh: 这就好比你在某种程度上付出艰辛努力、逼迫自己，也许是为了让你的孩子们不必经历那种苦工，但同时你又希望她们能有所成就。

sentences.en: You don't want them to, to not reach their potential.
sentences.zh: 你不想让她们无法发挥出自己的潜力。

sentences.en: And like I said, I know from experience, it was definitely worth it.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，我根据经验知道，这绝对是值得的。

sentences.en: I can confirm that.
sentences.zh: 我可以证实这一点。

sentences.en: So for me, it's like trying to get into a place where I do feel comfortable saying like, okay, girls, we're going to do this every day, but it also takes a lot of commitment
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，这就像是试图进入这样一种状态：我能够安心地对孩子们说，好吧，宝贝们，我们每天都要做这件事，但这同时也需要父母付出巨大的承诺。

sentences.en: from the parent.
sentences.zh: 父母付出巨大的承诺。

sentences.en: And that's why I said, now I have so much respect for my mom and my dad, because I was like, okay, Olympia, we're going to play tennis every Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我说，现在我对我的妈妈和爸爸充满了敬意，因为我当时想的是：好吧，奥林匹亚，我们每周三都要打网球。

sentences.en: And then I'm now, I'm like, uh.
sentences.zh: 然后现在，我心里想的是：呃。

sentences.en: And do you ever talk with Venus about why she still plays?
sentences.zh: 你有没有跟大威聊过她为什么还在继续打球？

sentences.en: Like, do you understand why she's still out there?
sentences.zh: 比如，你理解她为什么还在赛场上拼搏吗？

sentences.en: And Venus loves tennis.
sentences.zh: 大威热爱网球。

sentences.en: And I think the question will be best answered from her.
sentences.zh: 我想这个问题由她来回答会最好。

sentences.en: I do not want to speak for her, but I do know that that's something that, I mean, we both love tennis.
sentences.zh: 我不想替她发言，但我确实知道那是……我是说，我们俩都热爱网球。

sentences.en: Honestly, I feel like I would still be playing if I didn't have to stop and have a family.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我觉得如果我不是不得不停下来组建家庭，我现在应该还在打球。

sentences.en: Can I ask you a slightly tennis nerdy question?
sentences.zh: 我能问你一个稍微有点网球宅味的问题吗？

sentences.en: Oh, for sure.
sentences.zh: 噢，当然可以。

sentences.en: In the documentary, I think it's, you're talking and I think it's, you know, you're reminiscing about after winning your first slam.
sentences.zh: 在纪录片里，我想是……你在说话，我想那是……你在回忆赢得第一个大满贯之后的事情。

sentences.en: And you say that after that, you really had a bullseye on your back, that the other players on tour were really like, we got to beat the Williams sisters.
sentences.zh: 你说在那之后，你的背上真的像被画了个靶子，巡回赛里的其他球员都在想：我们必须击败威廉姆斯姐妹。

sentences.en: What did you think that was about back then?
sentences.zh: 你觉得当时那究竟是怎么回事？

sentences.en: And is your perspective on it now different?
sentences.zh: 现在你对这件事的看法有什么不同吗？

sentences.en: I definitely had a red X on me and it was hard.
sentences.zh: 我身上绝对被打上了红叉，那段日子很难熬。

sentences.en: It was, you know, people assume that you're not friendly and that's usually not the case.
sentences.zh: 确实，你知道的，人们会觉得你不好接近，但通常情况并非如此。

sentences.en: You're just there to win.
sentences.zh: 你只是去那里赢的。

sentences.en: And, you know, people don't really want to talk to winners in a single sport to be, you know, it's like the birds of a feather flock together and there's only one winner.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，人们其实并不太想在单人运动中和赢家说话，你知道的，这就好比物以类聚，而赢家只有一个。

sentences.en: And so who are you going to flock with?
sentences.zh: 所以你要和谁物以类聚呢？

sentences.en: And if I were playing soccer, it'd be a completely different situation because you have a team of players.
sentences.zh: 如果我踢的是足球，情况就会完全不同，因为你有一个球员组成的团队。

sentences.en: I had my mom and my dad and, you know, we kept ourselves really close because we had to.
sentences.zh: 我有我妈和我爸，而且，你知道的，我们一家人关系非常紧密，因为我们必须这样。

sentences.en: But yeah, I do feel like it shook the world.
sentences.zh: 不过是的，我觉得这确实震撼了世界。

sentences.en: I mean, come on, like a Black girl wins a Grand Slam at 17 years old and she's from Compton.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，拜托，一个17岁的黑人女孩在康普顿长大，却赢得了大满贯。

sentences.en: If you're not going to take notice, the world took notice of it.
sentences.zh: 如果你不予关注，全世界都对此给予了关注。

sentences.en: So obviously they took notice.
sentences.zh: 所以很显然，他们注意到了。

sentences.en: And so it had been a dominated sport by, you know, Caucasians.
sentences.zh: 而且你知道的，这项运动一直以来都被白人所主导。

sentences.en: So it was like, whoa, we're having a change in our sport.
sentences.zh: 所以大家的反应是，哇，我们的运动正在发生变革。

sentences.en: We don't like that.
sentences.zh: 我们可不喜欢这样。

sentences.en: This isn't normal.
sentences.zh: 这可不正常。

sentences.en: Let's not let her win.
sentences.zh: 别让她赢。

sentences.en: And so that's quite frankly what it was.
sentences.zh: 坦白讲，当时情况就是这样。

sentences.en: And do you find any of the same racial dynamics in play?
sentences.zh: 你觉得其中是否存在同样的种族动态？

sentences.en: No, I didn't say race.
sentences.zh: 不，我没说种族。

sentences.en: I didn't say that it was racial.
sentences.zh: 我没说这是关于种族的。

sentences.en: I just said that, to be clear, I said that it was a change.
sentences.zh: 为了说清楚，我只是说这是一场变革。

sentences.en: And just like anything, like you're going to notice if it was an Asian person winning everything when there was only white people winning before, right?
sentences.zh: 就像任何事情一样，如果以前只有白人赢球，而现在一个亚裔赢了所有比赛，你也会注意到，对吧？

sentences.en: So I happened to be Black and it happened to be me and I happened to win a Grand Slam and I happened to be young.
sentences.zh: 所以碰巧我是黑人，碰巧是我，碰巧我赢了大满贯，而且碰巧我还很年轻。

sentences.en: And it was like, whoa, this hasn't happened since the 50s.
sentences.zh: 当时的情况就是，哇，这自50年代以来就没发生过。

sentences.en: So obviously it's going to take note.
sentences.zh: 所以这显然会引起注意。

sentences.en: And obviously it was like, well, we're not used to this.
sentences.zh: 显然大家的反应是，嗯，我们不习惯这样。

sentences.en: So we want to make sure that we make our comeback too.
sentences.zh: 所以我们要确保自己也能卷土重来。

sentences.en: This is a semi-random question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个半随机的问题。

sentences.en: Did you see Challengers?
sentences.zh: 你看过《挑战者》吗？

sentences.en: That is so random.
sentences.zh: 这也太随机了。

sentences.en: And yes, I did see Challengers.
sentences.zh: 不过是的，我看过《挑战者》。

sentences.en: Thoughts?
sentences.zh: 有什么感想？

sentences.en: I thought it was good.
sentences.zh: 我觉得挺好看的。

sentences.en: I wanted there to be more of an ending.
sentences.zh: 我希望结局能更完整一些。

sentences.en: I was like, I told Zendaya, I was like, listen, is there more?
sentences.zh: 我当时就对赞达亚说，听着，还有后续吗？

sentences.en: Like I want more.
sentences.zh: 就像我想要看更多一样。

sentences.en: Did they win?
sentences.zh: 他们赢了吗？

sentences.en: I mean, I don't want to give away the inner ending, but yeah, I thought it was quite interesting.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我不想剧透最后的结局，但是是的，我觉得它相当有趣。

sentences.en: Did you see it?
sentences.zh: 你看过吗？

sentences.en: I did see it.
sentences.zh: 我看过。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: What did you think of it?
sentences.zh: 你觉得怎么样？

sentences.en: I liked it.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢。

sentences.en: You know, I just kept wondering about the accuracy of the tennis in it.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我一直在想里面网球动作的准确性。

sentences.en: I think they did really good, actually.
sentences.zh: 其实我觉得他们做得非常好。

sentences.en: I think for the most part, I thought the tennis was very well done.
sentences.zh: 我觉得在很大程度上，我认为网球部分拍得非常出色。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And it's like on any level, did those sort of interpersonal rivalries and dynamics ring true for you?
sentences.zh: 在任何层面上，那种人际间的竞争和动态对你来说是否真实？

sentences.en: So, yeah, I thought they, I thought it was pretty accurate too about, you know, the tennis player and the relationship that they had.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我也觉得关于网球运动员以及他们之间的关系，拍得相当准确。

sentences.en: I felt like sometimes you can become really connected to whoever you're with, whether that's a friend, a coach or codependent, I should say is a better word.
sentences.zh: 我觉得有时候你会与身边的任何人产生极深的联系，无论是朋友、教练，或者我应该用一个更好的词——共生关系。

sentences.en: Like, I feel like I was codependent with Venus.
sentences.zh: 比如，我觉得我和维纳斯之间就是共生关系。

sentences.en: I actually felt like there was so much accuracy in there about things that are, we don't think about as tennis players or even talk about as tennis players.
sentences.zh: 实际上我觉得里面有很多细节非常准确，讲到了我们作为网球运动员平时不会去想、甚至不会去谈论的事情。

sentences.en: There's definitely a lot of codependent, I feel.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这里面绝对有很多共生关系。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: It could go both ways.
sentences.zh: 这也可能因人而异。

sentences.en: You could also be a loner in tennis.
sentences.zh: 你在网球界也可以是一个独行侠。

sentences.en: So I don't know.
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道。

sentences.en: I don't, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，我真的不知道。

sentences.en: Listen, I like the movie.
sentences.zh: 听着，我喜欢这部电影。

sentences.en: That's all I can say.
sentences.zh: 这就是我能说的全部。

sentences.en: But everyone is allowed to have their own opinion.
sentences.zh: 但每个人都有权拥有自己的观点。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You know, I also saw the, this sort of news come out of the Trump trial that you were in the president's contacts.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我还看到特朗普审判中爆出这样一条新闻，说你是总统通讯录里的人。

sentences.en: You guys would talk to each other?
sentences.zh: 你们以前会互相交流吗？

sentences.en: I mean, is this what this interview is about?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这次采访就是为了聊这个吗？

sentences.en: Oh, it just, so when somebody has a chance to talk to a president, I'm curious what they talk to a president about.
sentences.zh: 哦，这只是因为，当有人有机会跟总统对话时，我很好奇他们会跟总统聊些什么。

sentences.en: I talk to a lot of presidents, so.
sentences.zh: 我和很多总统聊过，所以……

sentences.en: I spoke to Barack.
sentences.zh: 我和巴拉克谈过。

sentences.en: I spoke to Clintons.
sentences.zh: 我和克林顿谈过。

sentences.en: I spoke to every president since I've been alive, including Ronald Reagan.
sentences.zh: 自我出生以来，我和历任总统都谈过，包括罗纳德·里根。

sentences.en: I'll have you know.
sentences.zh: 我要提醒你一下。

sentences.en: Oh, really?
sentences.zh: 哦，真的吗？

sentences.en: What do you think they're looking for in talking to you?
sentences.zh: 你觉得他们找你谈话是想得到什么？

sentences.en: What do they want to know?
sentences.zh: 他们想知道什么？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I'm not going to go there.
sentences.zh: 我不会顺着这个话题往下说的。

sentences.en: Fair enough.
sentences.zh: 好吧，也有道理。

sentences.en: You talked a little bit about the idea of your, for lack of a better term, like legacy and what you achieved.
sentences.zh: 你刚才稍微谈到了你的——如果换个更好的词的话——传承，以及你所取得的成就。

sentences.en: And it does really seem like in the last few years, there has been this explosion of interest in women's sports.
sentences.zh: 而且看起来确实在过去的几年里，人们对女子体育的兴趣出现了爆发式增长。

sentences.en: And I think it's inarguable that you were a big part of that.
sentences.zh: 我认为无可争辩的是，你是其中的重要推动力。

sentences.en: Like, do you feel some sense of responsibility for the position women's sports is in now?
sentences.zh: 比如，你对女子体育现在的地位是否有一种责任感？

sentences.en: No, I would feel that way if it were tennis.
sentences.zh: 不，如果是网球的话，我可能会有那种感觉。

sentences.en: And I know it's not linear, but I don't want to be presumptuous.
sentences.zh: 我知道这不是线性的，但我不想妄自尊大。

sentences.en: Listen, these women are working so hard at what they do.
sentences.zh: 听着，这些女性在她们的领域里工作极其努力。

sentences.en: And, you know, whether it's Angel Reese or Caitlin Clark, they deserve the attention that they're starting to get.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，无论是安吉尔·里斯还是凯特琳·克拉克，她们都配得上现在开始受到的关注。

sentences.en: And I wasn't there.
sentences.zh: 而我当时不在那里。

sentences.en: I was doing my own different thing in tennis, right?
sentences.zh: 我在网球领域做着我自己的不同事情，对吧？

sentences.en: So I can't sit here and say that.
sentences.zh: 所以我不能坐在这里说：

sentences.en: It's because of me that women's sport is doing so good.
sentences.zh: 女子体育发展得这么好全都是因为我。

sentences.en: Like, that's just not, first of all, that's not me.
sentences.zh: 这绝对不是我的风格。

sentences.en: And I don't know if that would be 100% accurate.
sentences.zh: 而且我不知道这是否百分之百准确。

sentences.en: Women's sports athletes have been great for decades and way before me.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，女子体育运动员一直都很伟大，远在我之前就是这样。

sentences.en: I mean, Chris Everett was great and Martina Navratilova was great.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，克里斯·埃弗特很伟大，玛蒂娜·纳芙拉蒂洛娃也很伟大。

sentences.en: And maybe it's just the buildup of all that decades and decades of greatness.
sentences.zh: 也许这只是几十年又几十年伟大成就的累积。

sentences.en: And then people finally catching on that women are awesome and amazing and they could just kick butt in sport too.
sentences.zh: 然后人们终于意识到女性是如此优秀和惊艳，她们在体育界同样能大杀四方。

sentences.en: And so I don't know, maybe it's just a full compilation of it all.
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道，也许这只是这一切的完美结合。

sentences.en: So, um, and, you know, I, I am always curious with athletes about the memories that they have from their careers.
sentences.zh: 所以，呃，而且，你知道的，我对运动员职业生涯中的记忆一直都很好奇。

sentences.en: And do you find that you, you know, I don't know how much you sit back and think about this kind of stuff, but if you do, does your mind go to the big wins or, or the losses?
sentences.zh: 你是否发现自己——你知道的，我不知道你有多少次会坐下来思考这些事情，但如果你会的话，你的脑海里浮现的是那些伟大的胜利，还是……还是失败？

sentences.en: Um, I'm the kind of person that'd be like, oh, I hate it that I lost that.
sentences.zh: 呃，我是那种会觉得“哦，我恨我输了那场比赛”的人。

sentences.en: I try to forget my losses, to be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我尽量忘记我的失败。

sentences.en: Um, you know what?
sentences.zh: 呃，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I actually always refuse to go down memory lane during my career because I always said, that's when you get satisfied and that's how you not grow and not be better.
sentences.zh: 其实在我的职业生涯中，我一直拒绝回顾过去，因为我总是说，那会让你变得满足，而这正是你无法成长、无法变得更好的原因。

sentences.en: Because if I'm like looking at me and I'm one like 18 grand slams, I'll be like, oh my
sentences.zh: 因为如果我看着自己，心想我已经赢了18个大满贯，我就会觉得，哦，天哪，

sentences.en: God, that's amazing.
sentences.zh: 这太惊人了。

sentences.en: Why am I doing this?
sentences.zh: 我为什么还要做这些？

sentences.en: And so I didn't want to kind of have that mindset.
sentences.zh: 所以我不想有那种心态。

sentences.en: So I kind of never really looked back.
sentences.zh: 因此我几乎从不真正回头看。

sentences.en: And with everything going on with Serena in the arena, I have an opportunity to look back and say, wow, this has been really, really cool and really interesting.
sentences.zh: 随着“Serena in the arena”（塞雷娜在竞技场）的一切进行，我有了回顾过去的机会，并感叹，哇，这段经历真的很棒、非常有趣。

sentences.en: Like to kind of remember that, ah, it felt good.
sentences.zh: 就像去回味那种感觉一样，啊，这感觉真好。

sentences.en: You know, it's being the subject of a documentary is obviously something that most people don't get to experience.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，成为纪录片的主角显然是大多数人无法体验到的经历。

sentences.en: You know, just seeing sort of your, your life story played back to you in, in a narrative fashion.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，看着你的人生故事以叙事的方式重现在你面前。

sentences.en: What is that experience like and what were some of the interesting nuances of seeing how someone else like understands what the Serena Williams story is?
sentences.zh: 那是一种什么样的体验，当看到别人如何理解塞雷娜·威廉姆斯的故事时，有哪些有趣的细微差别？

sentences.en: I am always amazed at people and the excitement they have for what I've done.
sentences.zh: 每当看到人们对我所做的事情表现出热情和兴奋时，我总是感到惊讶。

sentences.en: I'm just like, I'm just an, I'm just a normal person, you know, like I've been so in a box of just like staying focused and just like, you know, just like, I don't know, just doing
sentences.zh: 我当时就觉得，我只是个，我只是个普通人，你知道的，我一直被局限在专注自我、只知道，你知道的，只知道，我不知道，只做

sentences.en: the best that I could on that day and just, that's all I could do.
sentences.zh: 自己在那天能做到的最好，而那是我唯一能做的事。

sentences.en: So now just having an opportunity to hear people talk, you know, about it almost gets me super emotional.
sentences.zh: 所以现在有机会听到人们谈论这些，你知道的，这几乎让我超级情绪化。

sentences.en: And it's just like, wow, I just, honestly, I just didn't know.
sentences.zh: 感觉就是，哇，老实说，我以前真的不知道。

sentences.en: I just didn't know.
sentences.zh: 我真的不知道。

sentences.en: Tell me more about that because you, you were like in it so you couldn't see outside of it or?
sentences.zh: 多跟我讲讲这个，因为你当时身处其中，所以你看不到局外的事情，是吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, obviously I knew, but it's also just, I'm so in it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，显然我知道，但这也只是因为我太专注其中了。

sentences.en: I would literally win Wimbledon and I would go back the next day and tell, not even the next day.
sentences.zh: 我literally（简直）会赢得温网冠军，然后第二天就回去告诉……甚至都不是第二天。

sentences.en: I remember having a conversation with my dad being like, okay, dad.
sentences.zh: 我记得我曾和我爸爸谈过，我说，好吧，爸爸。

sentences.en: So that was great, but I really want to focus on, I know I can win the open.
sentences.zh: 所以那很棒，但我真的很想专注于，我知道我能赢得美网冠军。

sentences.en: And it's just like, I literally never really took too much time to like settle in and my wins.
sentences.zh: 而且感觉就是，我literally（简直）从未真正花太多时间去沉浸在我的胜利中。

sentences.en: And I just was always looking for the next quote unquote high for lack of a better word.
sentences.zh: 我总是为了换个更好的词寻找下一个所谓的“嗨点”。

sentences.en: And it was always more competition?
sentences.zh: 总是为了更多的竞争吗？

sentences.en: It was always the next, the next win.
sentences.zh: 总是为了下一个，下一场胜利。

sentences.en: Do you still find yourself looking for the next quote unquote high?
sentences.zh: 你现在发现自己还在寻找下一个所谓的“嗨点”吗？

sentences.en: I have so much more excitement now with just relaxing.
sentences.zh: 现在光是放松就能让我感到兴奋得多了。

sentences.en: Um, and this has been a process of trying to find my new normal.
sentences.zh: 呃，这也是一个试图寻找我新的常态的过程。

sentences.en: And now I'm like getting to a point where my day today ends at 12 and I'm like, I have a massage at one 30 and it's just like, it's kind of nice to,
sentences.zh: 现在我达到了这样一种状态：我的一天在12点结束，然后我想，我一点半有个按摩，这感觉其实挺好的，

sentences.en: you know, have an opportunity
sentences.zh: 你知道的，

sentences.en: to just take a deep breath in and deep breath out.
sentences.zh: 有机会深深地吸一口气再深深地呼出来。

sentences.en: Cause I've never, I've never had that.
sentences.zh: 因为我从来没有过这样的经历。

sentences.en: And I've always gone from the next thing, you know, so I'm trying to enjoy this.
sentences.zh: 我总是从一件事赶往下一件事，你知道的，所以我正努力享受这一切。

sentences.en: After the break, I call Serena back to talk tennis rivalries and more about what she's looking for in this next era of her life.
sentences.zh: 休息过后，我将再次连线塞雷娜，聊聊网球宿敌以及更多关于她在人生下一阶段所追求的东西。

sentences.en: I have images of me in a stroller on a tennis court.
sentences.zh: 我还保留着自己坐在网球场边婴儿车里的照片。

sentences.en: So it's literally my entire life.
sentences.zh: 所以这literally（简直）就是我的一生。

sentences.en: I've been about one thing.
sentences.zh: 我所有的精力都扑在了一件事上。

sentences.en: And I like that I miss tennis.

sentences.en: I would hate to be like, oh, I hated that so much.
sentences.zh: 要是我觉得“哦，我以前太讨厌那个了”，那就糟了。

sentences.en: And like, that would be such an awful, like sad thing for me because tennis meant so much to me.
sentences.zh: 那样对我来说会是一件很糟糕、很悲伤的事，因为网球对我的意义太重大了。

sentences.en: And I didn't realize it meant that much to me, to be honest, and I didn't realize that I would have such an amazing relationship with tennis after it was all said and done.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我以前没意识到它对我有这么重大意义，我也没有意识到在这一切结束之后，我和网球之间还能拥有如此美妙的关系。

sentences.en: And I love that.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢这样。

sentences.en: I'm really, I'm really happy that I have that relationship.
sentences.zh: 我真的、真的很庆幸自己能拥有这种关系。

sentences.en: It's like a good miss.
sentences.zh: 这是一种美好的思念。

sentences.en: It's like a good, it's like a nostalgia, but you know, nostalgia is positive.
sentences.zh: 这就像是一种怀旧，但你知道，怀旧是积极的。

sentences.en: So I love that.
sentences.zh: 所以我很喜欢。
